name: R831
summary: R831 is an online action RPG set thousands of years in the future, on generated planets where a machine rules humanity. The player is an outcast at the edge of settled space who draws power from prayer. Starting alone with bare hands, the player gathers materials, makes camp, fights and learns abilities, then meets the world's people, finds the church and takes on quests. Claiming land lets the player raise a haven, take in refugees and defend them against night raids. Later the game moves outward into dark places and battles, vows of faith, and travel by skiff to a second planet. Worlds, enemies, characters and loot are procedurally generated, and progress is stored online. Friends can join each other's worlds. The game is free to play, with cosmetics sold in a shop.
